origin.description: Convert text to composed normal form, with optional case, compatibility, quote, and ignorable maps.
origin.usage: utf8_normalize(x, map_case = FALSE, map_compat = FALSE, map_quote = FALSE, remove_ignorable = FALSE)

arguments.name: map_case
arguments.text: Casefold. With map_compat, only ASCII letters change.

arguments.name: map_quote
arguments.text: Map a few apostrophe-like characters to U+0027.

arguments.name: remove_ignorable
arguments.text: Drop characters utf8lite marks as default ignorable.

origin.details: The angstrom sign and A plus a ring both compose to Å.

translation.description: NFC, or NFKC when compatibility is requested. Casefold runs only when compatibility is off.

arguments.name: map_case
arguments.text: Casefold. With map_compat, only ASCII letters change.

arguments.name: map_quote
arguments.text: Map a few apostrophe-like characters to U+0027.

arguments.name: remove_ignorable
arguments.text: Drop characters utf8lite marks as default ignorable.

translation.details: Setting map_compat clears the Unicode casefold in utf8lite, so Å stays Å while ABC becomes abc.
translation.example:
from utf8 import utf8_normalize
angstrom = ["\u00c5", "A\u030a", "\u212b"]
print(" ".join(utf8_normalize(angstrom)))
